review.tagline: Reference TensorFlow 2 model implementations, plus the Orbit training-loop library
review.summary: Repository of TensorFlow model implementations split into official (maintained by the TensorFlow team), research (maintained by researchers, TF1 or TF2) and a curated community list. It also includes Orbit, a lightweight library for custom TF2 training loops that works with tf.distribute on CPU, GPU and TPU. Installable as tf-models-official or the nightly tf-models-nightly package.
review.audience: TensorFlow users needing reference model code or custom training loops
strengths: Official directory is maintained by the TensorFlow team against current TF2 APIs
Orbit supports custom training loops with tf.distribute on CPU, GPU and TPU
Published on PyPI as tf-models-official, with a daily nightly build
Training logs on TensorBoard.dev provided for some models
weaknesses: Research directory is researcher-maintained and mixes TensorFlow 1 and 2 code
tf-models-official may lag master; nightly package needed for latest changes
Source install needs manual PYTHONPATH setup and extra requirements
GitHub reports license as NOASSERTION, although the README states Apache 2.0
